requirement.statement: The Element Plus schema-editor capsule SHALL provide product-ready adapters for every default compiler presenter id and common scalar format aliases without an implicit JSON or raw-value fallback.

case.given: An EditorPlan contains object.group, scalar text/number/boolean/null/enum/const, collection.list, map.entries, union.select, schema.ref and unsupported presenter ids
case.when: The default Element Plus presenter registry resolves each id
case.then: Every id SHALL resolve to an explicit adapter and unsupported SHALL render an observable non-editable diagnostic

case.given: Scalar fields use common email, password, multiline, URL, telephone, date, time, datetime, color or currency formats
case.when: The compiler emits scalar format presenter ids
case.then: The default registry SHALL resolve explicit Element Plus adapters whose emitted values remain contract-serializable

case.given: A plan names an unregistered custom format presenter
case.when: The registry resolves the id
case.then: The renderer SHALL fail closed and SHALL NOT select a JSON textarea, raw editor or code editor

requirement.statement: Each presenter SHALL render renderer-complete plan metadata and accepted session projection while enforcing visibility, read-only, required, pending and diagnostic state ahead of presenter options.

case.given: A field has label, description, required, readOnly, visible, options and diagnostics metadata
case.when: Its presenter renders
case.then: The UI SHALL expose applicable labels, help, required and diagnostics, hide invisible content and disable writes for readOnly content

case.given: A SchemaEditorSession request is pending
case.when: A presenter renders the current projection
case.then: Write controls SHALL be disabled and the displayed value SHALL remain the last accepted snapshot

case.given: Presenter options attempt to replace model value, disabled state, event wiring, recursive slots or runtime capabilities
case.when: The adapter maps options to Element Plus props
case.then: The adapter SHALL ignore or reject unsafe options and preserve plan and session ownership

requirement.statement: Element Plus presenters SHALL convert discoverable field, collection, map and union interactions into exactly the existing serializable normalized Schema Editor events and SHALL never modify accepted values directly.

case.given: A writable scalar or reference control changes
case.when: The Element Plus component emits its native event
case.then: The presenter SHALL emit value.change with a serializable value payload and SHALL NOT mutate props.value

case.given: A collection presenter receives accepted items and recursive child VNodes from the Vue renderer slot
case.when: The user inserts, removes, moves up or moves down an item
case.then: The presenter SHALL emit item.insert, item.remove or item.move with normalized indexes and defaults

case.given: A map presenter receives accepted own entries and recursive child VNodes from the Vue renderer slot
case.when: The user adds, removes or renames an entry
case.then: The presenter SHALL emit entry.set, entry.remove or entry.rename with normalized keys and defaults

case.given: A union presenter receives ordered alternative descriptors and the selected recursive child slot
case.when: The user selects an alternative
case.then: The presenter SHALL emit alternative.select with alternativeId and the descriptor initialValue

case.given: An object, collection, map or union presenter has recursive content
case.when: The presenter renders that content
case.then: All recursive child VNodes SHALL come only from the completed Vue renderer default slot

requirement.statement: The Element Plus capsule SHALL construct frozen instance-local presenter registries and SHALL provide explicit composition in which caller-ordered business registries can override default presenters with a declared later-wins policy.

case.given: Two applications create default presenter registries
case.when: One application composes business overrides
case.then: The other application registry SHALL remain unchanged and no module-global mutable registry SHALL exist

case.given: A default registry and ordered business registries bind the same stable presenter id
case.when: The caller explicitly chooses last-wins composition
case.then: The last business registry SHALL resolve for that composition only

case.given: One default registry definition contains duplicate stable ids
case.when: The registry factory validates its entries
case.then: Creation SHALL fail closed with structured diagnostics

requirement.statement: The Element Plus capsule SHALL provide a composition helper and a runnable kitchen-sink canonical bundle that reuse the existing lowering, loader, compiler, app runtime, canonical renderer, Vue schema-editor shell and scoped Session.

case.given: An Element Plus canonical parent registry, default presenter registry and optional business presenter registries
case.when: The canonical composition helper binds component identity Editor
case.then: The sole schemaEditor.Editor shell SHALL resolve through the existing canonical renderer with the explicitly composed presenter registry

case.given: The kitchen-sink schema, presentation and accepted initial value cover every presenter family, nested structures and presentation state
case.when: The bundle is lowered, loaded, compiled, mounted and interacted with
case.then: All controls and normalized edit operations SHALL run through the real canonical lifecycle with zero loader, compiler or runtime errors

case.given: The kitchen-sink ValueHost produces pending, reject, conflict, stale and accepted outcomes
case.when: Users edit fields and structural values
case.then: The DOM SHALL advance only after an accepted snapshot and SHALL retain the prior accepted value for every non-accepted outcome

requirement.statement: The Element Plus schema-editor capsule SHALL depend only on public Halfcode contract/support/Vue APIs, Element Plus APIs, and presenter-internal UI engine dependencies explicitly declared by this capability; it SHALL NOT own compilation, session lifecycle, recursive rendering, lowering, host mutation or persistence capabilities.

case.given: Presenter props, component-local engine runtime, registry factories and canonical composition inputs.
case.when: Ownership and dependency scans run.
case.then: No presenter SHALL receive or capture Session, ValueHost, host writer, Flow, XNL mutation, VFS, database or browser persistence capability; structured-value engine loaders and editor instances SHALL remain restricted to the explicit presenter internals.

case.given: The Element Plus package source graph.
case.when: Public and dependency boundary tests run.
case.then: The package SHALL NOT implement a second compiler, Session, recursive renderer, canonical renderer, loader or lowering path; Monaco and vanilla-jsoneditor SHALL be treated only as presenter-internal UI engines.

case.given: StructureSchema, EditorPresentation, EditorPlan and lowered canonical source.
case.when: Default or business presenters are composed.
case.then: No component implementation, engine loader, callback, registry object or runtime value SHALL be written into those serializable data structures.

case.given: Ownership scans encounter JSON serialization or a code editor.
case.when: The source is inspected.
case.then: Such behavior SHALL be accepted only inside the explicit structured-value presenter path and SHALL remain forbidden as an implicit fallback in every other presenter.

requirement.statement: The collection presenter SHALL translate a completed drag into exactly one serializable item.move interaction even when the browser omits native dragend, and SHALL NOT directly mutate accepted collection data.

case.given: Sortable reports a collection move and native dragend arrives
case.when: The drag session completes
case.then: The presenter SHALL emit exactly one item.move and cancel any pending fallback

case.given: Sortable reports canonical old and new indices but the browser omits native dragend
case.when: The delayed completion fallback runs
case.then: The presenter SHALL emit exactly one item.move using the reported indices
